exact.review: Bright instrument edges stay intact. All methods retain broad structure and miss parts of the faint pattern.
The pale wall stays close to the aligned parent. Narrow vertical structure around the frame is still soft.
Directional and uniform corrections look close across the bright folds. The larger false projection is localized within the exact break.

Coarse crossings stay coherent. Directional and uniform lifts look similar.
